title: Canva adds an AI ‘off’ button
slides: Canva just handed users an AI off switch — why?
The design tool's AI features were always optional, technically
But the switch sits in a settings menu most never open
Your workflow may silently depend on AI-suggested templates
Try designing one project today without any AI help
thread_text:
1. AI off switch, but why now?

Canva added a toggle to disable AI features, but its placement in settings raises questions about how optional the tech really is.

2. Optional was never the point

Technically, every AI tool in Canva could be ignored from day one. The new switch just makes that choice explicit — and harder to avoid.

3. Settings graveyard strikes again

The toggle lives in a menu most users never open. That means the off switch exists more for PR than for daily use.

4. Workflow trap: silent dependence

Template suggestions and auto-design quietly steer your choices. Turn AI off and your usual speed might vanish.

5. Try one project AI-free today

Design a single post without any AI help. If it takes twice as long, ask yourself: do you control the tool, or does it control you?

instagram.caption:
There's now a switch to turn off AI in Canva 🔘

The feature lives in a settings menu most people never open, so technically the off button has existed quietly rather than upfront.

Every AI tool was already optional — this toggle just makes the choice explicit, and easy to forget.

Here's the catch: template suggestions and auto-design may be steering your workflow without you noticing. Turn AI off and your usual speed could drop. ⚠️

If designing one post without help suddenly takes twice as long, that tells you something. 🕐

Try one project today with every AI feature disabled. Does your workflow still feel like yours?
